properties.description:
Planned 2026-10-01 on Anthony's word ("plan the plugin after the dependency PRs").

WHAT IT IS: one plugin folder in Claude Code's format, which Grok Build also reads:
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` at the release version;
- `.mcp.json` registering `reflow2-mcp --graph-path .reflow2/graph --shared --only-if-present`, the same entry today's user-scope registration writes;
- `commands/` and `skills/`;
- `hooks/hooks.json` carrying the loop nudge.
The Agent Plugins spec's root plugin.json and mcp.json sit beside it for the spec's other hosts.
It is listed in a `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` in reflow2's repository, so `claude plugin marketplace add flo2-connector/reflow2` and `grok plugin marketplace add flo2-connector/reflow2` find it. `claude plugin update` and `grok plugin update` keep it current.

WHY THIS SHAPE IS SAFE: measured on both hosts (fact:claude-code-and-grok-start-a-plugins-mcp-server-in-the-project-folder-2026-10-01).
- Both start a plugin's MCP server in the PROJECT folder, so the relative graph path finds the project's design unchanged.
- Both expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
- Both loaded a Claude-format plugin as-is.
- Only Claude Code offers MCP roots, so the working directory stays primary.

WHAT IT DOES NOT CHANGE:
- The binary still comes from install.sh ("plugins deliver files, not binaries", in both hosts' terms).
- reflow2_install.py and reflow2_init.py stay for every other client. They learn not to register a second `reflow2` server when the plugin is present.
- MCP stays the mechanism (rule:mcp-and-the-graph-are-the-only-common-ground). The plugin is an addition for the hosts that load it.

The plan: epoch:planned-reflow2-ships-as-a-plugin.
properties.name: reflow2 installs as one plugin that Claude Code and Grok Build both load — its MCP entry, commands, skills and loop-nudge hooks — from a marketplace in reflow2's own repository
